body.message:
Dear,

From the very first day we contacted you, our only request was to be provided with a clean apartment.

We explained this clearly to everyone involved, including the Guest Relations contact you provided, who unfortunately was not helpful at all.

We have our own standards and way of doing things. We do not allow anyone to enter the apartment to carry out cleaning or maintenance during our stay. It was your responsibility to ensure that the apartment was thoroughly cleaned before our arrival. This includes clean beds, bed covers, towels, sofas (which, by the way, are in very poor condition and extremely uncomfortable), air conditioning units, toilets, washing machine, doors, curtains, and every other part of the apartment.

Instead, we found that almost everything was dirty, and we had to clean it ourselves.

Unfortunately, the damage has already been done. We are extremely disappointed with the quality of your service, which is far below the standard that was promised. We will be sharing our experience online, along with photos, to warn future customers about the level of service they can expect.
